headline: Mercor says it is now a $20 billion company
body: AI training platform Mercor says it is now a $20 billion company after a $750 million Series D funding round. The company plans to use the financing to help train and test AI agents.
note: The CEO also said Mercor spends three times as much on inference as on employee salaries, a sign of how much model use now costs a company that trains models.

figure.label: valuation Mercor says it has reached

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) training platform Mercor says it is now a $20 billion company.
The company reached that valuation with its $750 million Series D funding round, announced Tuesday (Nov. 10).
Mercor, originally an AI-powered hiring platform, says it plans to use the financing to help train and test AI agents.
The CEO said Mercor is seeing the impact of AI investment on its own business, as it spends three times as much on inference as on employee salaries.
